summary: The Georgia lookout list places a gulf point tower in Walker County; no source describes its build, staffing, fate or the site today.

evidence.supports: List entry gulf point: Walker County, coordinates, and 2197 in the elevation column
The entry gives no unit for its elevation value
For towers 73 and above the list's names are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The entry carries the notes BLL-41108, map and gfc-704

notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms list row. Two web searches found no page naming a Gulf Point tower in Walker County. Cached NHLR and FFLOS Georgia index pages do not list it. The live nhlr.org and firetower.org pages refused the connection, so the cache is the only register check. A Nov 2023 wildfire on Lookout Mountain in Walker County damaged radio towers; the coverage names no lookout, so it is not used. The list also has a Johns Mountain Lookout Tower in Walker County (GA030) that this story does not cover. The story is about 83 words, under the 120-word guide floor, because no further evidence was found. The record's 669.6 m elevation assumes feet; the list gives no unit.
